1.o: تنقلب حياة "ويل" الجديدة حين يواجه شبحًا غامضًا، وتتواصل "إريتريا" مع شخص من ماضيها، ويكشف "ألانون" عن مكيدة خبيثة.

2.o: ينطلق "ويل" و"ماريث" بحثًا عن أجوبة ويتعارفان أكثر في طريقهما نحو الوادي الظليل، ويزور الملك "آندر" مملكة قريبة طلبًا للتعزيزات.

3.o: يتحمل "ألانون" السجن المؤلم، وعلى "إريتريا" و"ماريث" العمل سويًا لتحرير "ويل" الحبيس قبل نفاد الوقت.

4.o: ينطلق الثلاثي في رحلة إلى قلب أرض خطيرة باحثين عن إجابة، ويقابل "آندر" الأسرة الملكية في "لي"، إلا أن الأميرة تسبب له متاعب أكثر مما توقعه.

5.o: يمضي "ويل" و"ماريث" قُدمًا في خطتهما لمواجهة "باندون"، ولكن هل ستفرّق الأزمات والشكوك بين زمرة الأبطال الاستثنائية تلك؟

6.o: تحيد "ماريث" و"ويل" عن طريقهما في رحلة غامضة لاسترداد شيء مهم من مسقط رأس "ويل"... والوقت هو الجوهر.

7.o: يعمل "باندون" وأتباعه بجهد محموم لإعادة "سيد السحر" إلى الحياة. وفي الوقت نفسه، تسابق "ماريث" الزمن وتخاطر بكل شيء.

8.o: على "ويل" أن يواجه ماضيه، ثم يتركه يمضي. وبينما تتوطد العلاقة بين "ماريث" و"ألانون"، تُثبت قوى "باندون" الظلامية أن السيطرة عليها مستحيلة.

9.o: تعترف "إريتريا" اعترافًا سوداويًا، وينال "باندون" أمنيته، ولكن ثمة عقبة صغيرة تواجهه. كما تستمر قوى "سيد السحر" الجبارة في التعاظم.

10.o: مستقبل "الأراضي الأربعة" على المحك، وعلى "ماريث" و"ويل" استخدام قواهما لمقاتلة عدوهما الأخير.

1.o: Amy must act when she discovers her best mate is harbouring a mean-mouthed, hell-raised demon.

2.o: As if burying your best friend wasn't enough for one night. Amy and Raquel's exorcism attempt has put them firmly on Callum's radar.

3.o: What do you do when your best friend returns from the dead as a bloodsucking revenant? If you're Amy and Raquel, you take her captive...

4.o: How far would you go to protect the ones you love? Amy finds out as she and Raquel prepare to rescue Suzanne from Callum's evil clutches.

5.o: Raquel starts to fall for Harry, but Amy doesn't trust him. A flyer she finds in his wallet leads her to a discovery about Callum's plan.

6.o: Amy and Raquel go into hiding for Halloween, after a bottle of vodka and a game of Jenga it becomes apparent that they cannot trust even their closest allies. Amy faces her biggest challenge yet and it is Raquel.

1.o: Jack comes upon a monkey-man and agrees to train his tribe in the ways of defending themselves if the monkey-man teaches him how to "jump good".

2.o: Three short stories: Jack vs. the Worm: Jack confronts a two-headed riddling serpent who will grant him his wish if he can answer their questions;  The Metal-Eaters: Jack confronts a family that feed on metal and eat Jack's sword; Jack, the Gargoyle and the Fairy: Jack tries to rescue a wish-granting fairy from a gargoyle so that she may grant his wish to return home.

3.o: Jack is kidnapped and placed in a chain gang of warriors chosen to battle in front of a coliseum audience against the Dome of Doom's Champions.

4.o: The Scotsman needs Jack's help to save his kidnapped wife. But this woman is hardly the distressed damsel the Scotsman makes her out to be.

5.o: Jack goes from destroyed village to another looking for those responsible, only to find the destruction was commissioned by Aku.

6.o: Jack comes upon ruins of a village and realizes it is his home. He then reflects on the past when he was a young boy.

7.o: Jack travels vertically up a mountain with three monks to witness the magic of the mountain only to have the power of the mountain save his very life.

8.o: When a flatulent dragon begins stinking out an entire village. Jack slays the beast and ventures inside it to cure to source of its bellyache.

9.o: Aku hires the best hunters in the galaxy to track down the most elusive of prey - Samurai Jack.

10.o: Aku sends out Demongo, the soul collector, to destroy Jack. Now Jack must fight all the mighty warrior souls that Demongo has collected.

11.o: When Jack has his sword and clothing stolen, he must give chase to a white rabbit who took them while trying to maintain his modesty.

12.o: Jack comes upon a battle where a mere 300 men are fighting a vast, unending army of robots and their evil robotic leader.

13.o: When a band of bikes mow over Jack's sandals, he goes on a hunt for the perfect footwear.

1.o: Aku sends a Ninja to destroy Jack who is busily helping a port town in distress.

2.o: Jack enters a village to discover that he is their Chosen One meant to embody the Robo-Samurai and destroy the Mondo-bot that has come to destroy them.

3.o: Jack is approached by a cool Samurai-punk who wants to battle with Jack in order to prove that he is the best.

4.o: When ancient gods try to destroy a powerful evil, they send one piece of the beast hurtling through space. This piece lands on earth, spreading its evil through the land. When it encroaches on an Emperor's empire, he takes it upon himself to destroy the evil, but ends up unleashing the evil that is Aku.

5.o: Jack has lost all memory of who he is and it's up to the Scotsman to put the pieces of the puzzle together to save the samurai.

6.o: When Aku catches a cold and sneezes on Jack, Jack becomes infected with Aku’s badness which begins to take over his entire body.

7.o: When Aku raises the bounty on Jack, the best bounty hunters in the world gather to capture him.

8.o: Jack helps save a Prince and Princess whose ship has been shot down to Earth by Aku.

9.o: Tired of all the bounty hunters and robots failing, Aku fights Jack, mano y mano.

10.o: As Jack goes through fall, winter, spring and summer, he must battle the perils that each season brings.

11.o: Aku forces an old, ace robot assassin out of retirement to eliminate the ultimate mark - Jack.

12.o: Young Jack is brought to Africa for part of his training, but when his tribe is abducted, he must learn how to use their unique sword-like weapon – and fast!

13.o: Jack finds a baby and the two travel together as Jack tries to return the boy to his mother.

1.o: It's been 50 years since we last saw Samurai Jack and time has not been kind to him. Aku has destroyed every time portal and Jack has stopped aging, a side effect of time travel. It seems he is cursed to just roam the land for all eternity. His past haunts him as well as a cult of assasins dedicated to killing him for Aku's glory.

2.o: Jack's will to survive is pushed to its absolute limits after a deadly, unseen foe launches a relentless surprise attack.

3.o: Samurai Jack is gravely injured, but still decides to face one of the deadliest foes he's ever faced, Assassins from the Cult of Aku.

4.o: Samurai Jack partners with a deadly assassin in order to escape a gargantuan creature that has swallowed them whole.

5.o: Samurai Jack fights to save a group of enslaved people from being harvested as the power source for a monstrous Mega-Robot.

6.o: Ashi's search for Samurai Jack helps her to see his effect on the world after encountering numerous people and places where he has changed things for the better

7.o: Jack and Ashi overcome a series of dangerous physical and spiritual tests in order to recover Jack's sword.

8.o: The burgeoning relationship between Jack and Ashi takes a turn after they are hunted by one of the galaxy's deadliest creatures.

9.o: Samurai Jack's worst fear is realized when he faces off against Aku; the demon makes a shocking discovery about Ashi that puts her in grave danger.

10.o: The fate of the entire universe hangs in the balance as Samurai Jack faces Aku.

1.o: Tensions between rival gangs erupt while crime lord Samurai pulls politicians' strings. Three young crooks ally to seize an opportunity.

2.o: Samurai sinks his hooks into idealistic Cinaglia. Theodosiou's blackmailers try to silence a witness. Spadino chafes at his looming arranged marriage.

3.o: Samurai confronts Spadino over Theodosiou and hands Sara a raw deal. Cinaglia finds himself trapped. Manfredi targets Aureliano for revenge.

4.o: With a brewing war between the Anacletis and Adamis jeopardizing his control over the land deal, Samurai forces Gabriele into a terrible choice.

5.o: Livia and Aureliano vie for power. Samurai confronts Sara about her ploy. Spadino's secret complicates his wedding night.

6.o: Aureliano forces Sara into a deal, but she schemes to turn the tables. Cinaglia plays strong-arm politics. Theodosiou makes a desperate decision.

7.o: Samurai closes in as Sara tries to avert a Vatican scandal in return for the commission's votes. Livia reacts to Manfredi's move on her territory.

8.o: Scrambling to salvage the deal, Samurai summons Livia and Manfredi to a meeting. Sara faces a deception. Angelica discovers Spadino's secret.

9.o: Cinaglia doubles down on his political gamble, and Aureliano suffers a dangerous betrayal. Enthused over making a stand, Spadino takes a big risk.

10.o: Samurai drops the hammer, but Aureliano and Livia resist. Spadino takes charge, Cinaglia charts his future, and Gabriele faces a crisis of conscience.

1.o: While Cinaglia awaits the results of the political campaign, Samurai reaffirms its control over Aureliano and Lele. Spadino makes a shrewd move to have power.

2.o: Livia becomes a pawn and a victim in the battle between Spadino and his mother. Sara meets a new ally in the Vatican and Cinaglia risks big disobeying Samurai.

3.o: Aureliano swears revenge. Angelica devises a plan to help Spadino. Christian suspects more and more of Lele. Samurai pushes Sara to transfer the refugees.

4.o: Cinaglia confronts the consequences of defection with Samurai. Adelaide tries to control drug trafficking in Ostia. Lele asks Sara for help to conquer the Samurai.

5.o: Cinaglia conspires, while Samurai looks for a new alliance and the silence of an old friend. To regain control of Ostia, Aureliano becomes ruthless.

6.o: New alliances are born and the old ones disintegrate, while the blood flows and the tensions in the drug trafficking environments push Ostia towards a war.

7.o: After the outbreak of violence, Cinaglia reinforces the commitment to his bloodthirsty plan. Aureliano and Spadino reach an agreement and Lele faces the wrath of Samurai.

8.o: As the elections approach and Samurai loses power, Aureliano asks Nadia for help. Spadino is blackmailed and Lele makes a fateful choice.

1.o: Samurai, Cinaglia and Badali scheme to cash in on the Vatican's Jubilee celebration while Spadino forms a chilling plan to pull Cinaglia's strings.

2.o: Ambitious for yet more power, Aureliano and Spadino consolidate control of their alliance and turn their eyes to new turf: north Rome.

3.o: Spadino faces a renewed threat to his power. Cinaglia tries to back Cardinal Nascari into a corner. Nadia and Angelica learn the ropes in north Rome.

4.o: In the aftermath of the shooting, Aureliano and Spadino scramble to salvage their alliance. Cardinal Nascari tries to break Cinaglia's grip on him.

5.o: Discovering the truth, Spadino sets himself on a collision course with Manfredi. Alice comes to a fraught decision about Cinaglia.

6.o: Violence escalates out of control and lives are destroyed as the walls close in around Aureliano, Spadino and those they love.

1.o: Advances in neuroscience and engineering are bringing us closer to a reality first described only in great science fiction: artificial intelligence.

2.o: Will we one day stop the aging process? How would a dramatically protracted life change not only the fabric of society but what it means to be human?

3.o: As human activity transfers to virtual spaces, offering profound experiences via online personas, what does it mean for our perception of humanity?

4.o: Has constant connectivity affected privacy? In the deep future, will we become telepathic? And will we communicate with civilizations beyond Earth? Welcome to the new Era of Swarm Intelligence.

5.o: Overconsumption of energy and resources may force us to inhabit other planets through terraforming. Do humans have the right to claim other planets?

6.o: In the past century, the exploration of new planets has led humanity to question whether new life will be discovered and if the future will mirror science fiction.

1.o:
Four girls have different reasons for joining the Women's Land Army: patriotic Joyce wants to 'do her bit', argumentative Nancy is there under sufferance, and sensible Annie joined so that her younger sister Bea could escape an abusive father.

Bea rebels from her sister's control and finds herself enthralled by a charming GI, Cal Gillespie, while at the dance Nancy tries to get closer to Lord Hoxley.

2.o:
Bea has been hiding her pregnancy from everyone for three months, but it is becoming increasingly difficult. Tucker is on the prowl for enemy sympathisers and Nancy is in his sights.

Farmer Finch gets involved in a scam to flog home-made carrot whiskey, while Lord Hoxley realises that his marriage is over - and this drives him into the arms of Nancy. Meanwhile, Tucker finds Annie to tell her the devastating news that her husband has been killed in action.

3.o:
Three months on, and Annie is not dealing very well with Harry's death. Nancy and Lawrence's attraction has blossomed into a full-on affair. Meanwhile, Esther is screening Nancy's letters for Sergeant Tucker, fearing that she might be a Nazi collaborator.

Joyce, the patriot, has a dilemma - should she shelter her deserter husband or turn him in? Farmer Finch's old enemy Ernest Luckhurst, a food rations officer, arrives at the farm and is intent on catching him out.

4.o:
Farmer Finch hires some 'trekkers', families displaced by the bombing, as cheap labour, but when there is then a break-in at the manor house Lady Hoxley orders Finch to get rid of them all. A riot ensues and Tucker gets the dogs out.

The Hoxleys hold a swanky party, but after clashing with Nancy over a visit to her husband John, Joyce tells Lady Hoxley about the affair. Billy finally proposes to Bea, but she goes into labour before she can answer.

5.o:
Bea prepares for her wedding to Billy and discovers that Finch has doubts about her motives. Determined to leave, Nancy is shocked to the core when Ellen reveals Lawrence's dark secret. Will Annie choose her duty to Harry or her love for Adam?

Meanwhile, Tucker sets out on a trail of murderous revenge that will have shocking consequences for Nancy, Annie, Bea and Joyce.

1.o: A new girl, Connie, arrives at the farm and sets her sights on Billy. The manor house has been commandeered by the Americans, which excites Lady Hoxley's sister, Diana (Raquel Cassidy). John visits Joyce at the farm and Martin has an accident. Tucker is released from prison. Finch enters his pig into a county show, so it can avoid slaughter.

2.o: Following his fall, Martin is found to have detached retinas. He is also hiding an injured man. Diana tries to help Jack find his grandson and Joyce receives bad news about John. Finch tries to keep his contraband deals from Mrs Gulliver (Carolyn Pickles). Bea becomes friends with Salvatore Zappulo (Cesare Taurasi), an Italian POW, while Connie flirts with piano player, Henry (Liam Garrigan).

3.o: Bea allows Jack to meet his grandson. Connie discovers that Henry is actually a Reverend. Joyce follows Martin and finds Ulrich Keitmeiler (Benjamin Wilkin), the German airman he has been hiding. Esther is desperate for money to pay for Martin's operation, so Finch organises a boxing match with Vernon Storey (David Schofield).

4.o: A week later, Joyce is still in shock after shooting Ulrich dead. Connie helps Joseph Price (Sam Walton), a young evacuee, reunite with his sister and mother. Tucker works with Billy to improve his shooting and Jack tries to convince Bea to come to Chicago with him. After being turned down by Lady Hoxley, Esther asks Vernon for the money for Martin's operation.

5.o:
Connie stands up to the overbearing Bishop in order to win Henry's respect. Finch blows his top when he discovers how Esther received the money for Martin's operation. 

Joyce is angry and disillusioned with the Land Army, and she forces Tucker into an admission of guilt. Lady Hoxley's sister Diana is part of Jack's plan to make a getaway with Bea and the baby. Billy's family is being ripped apart, and he seems disinterested; what is he hiding?

1.o: At Hoxley Manor Lady Ellen turns the Great Hall into a hospital with the help of the land girls and ends up being confronted by a face from the past when Dr Channing shows up. At Pasture Farm, Joyce is still waiting for news about John, who is believed to be missing in action. Finch ends up drunkenly driving into Mrs Gulliver's garden and causes havoc. A telegram ends up arriving for Joyce and it has good news inside, John is still alive.

2.o: After Iris is called to the farm by Vernon for her proficiency test, the huge threshing machine ends up throwing her to the ground. Connie ends up throwing down the gauntlet and challenges Vernon to a farmers versus land girls ploughing competition. Channing attempts to reassure Joyce that John needs reassurance from her. After Connie goes to see Henry at church she is shocked to see Danny there chatting to him.

3.o: John thinks about the flashbacks he is having of his escape from France and talks to Dr Channing about them. Joyce ends up intervening when John can't take any more. Esther has to deal with her problems and starts to think about her options. Finch ends up offering her another solution. Frank informs Ellen about the suspicious man he saw in the woods and she ends up calling the police.

4.o: Danny threatens to hurt Henry if Connie doesn't submit to his will. Ellen considers if she can trust the man she loves. As Joyce and John grow closer John struggles with guilt over his infidelity. A revelation drives Martin even further away from Esther. Iris is in mourning whilst Walter and Frank square up for a fight with disastrous consequences.

5.o: Events spiral out of control for Connie when her shady past catches up with her. Iris makes a shocking discovery, whilst John is given some crushing news and Esther decides to face her critics in the village. Meanwhile, can Ellen keep up the pretence with Richard?

1.o: When four Indian operatives are taken hostage by the Taliban, a secret service director asks former agent Kabir Anand to take on the rescue mission.

2.t: When Sorrows Come, They Come Not Single Spies, but in Battalions
2.o: Secret codes left at a murder scene prompt Kabir to reconsider Sadiq’s proposed mission in Balochistan and bring on board two unlikely agents.

3.t: So Quick Bright Things Come to Confusion
3.o: A key detail emerges about Khalid's location. Kabir taps into a personal link to the Balochi resistance. Joshi learns of the unsanctioned mission.

4.t: Love All, Trust a Few, Do Wrong to None
4.o: A mystery woman from Kabir’s past returns. As the agents devise a risky new plan, Kabir recounts the truth about his last mission in Balochistan.

5.o: Despite hitting a snag, the agents’ oil pipeline job galvanizes the BAF. Khalid begins to doubt Shehzad, who has suspicions of his own.

6.t: Heat Not a Furnace for Your Foe So Hot That It Do Singe Yourself
6.o: Kabir strikes a deal in exchange for an escape route. Veer is met with a surprise at Shehzad’s hideout, while the pursuit of Khalid goes awry.

7.t: My Stronger Guilt Defeats My Strong Intent
7.o: With the clock ticking, a showdown occurs at the Taliban stronghold and Kabir races to catch up to Shehzad -- but a curveball is yet to come.

1.o: On the day Elena officially becomes Crown Princess, she must rescue her sister Isabel from aboard a missing ship.

2.o: Elena is torn between a promise she made to help Isabel and fulfilling her royal duties as crown princess.

3.o: Elena finds herself at odds with the Grand Council when dealing with a magical rock whose anger can trigger a “monfuego” eruption.

4.o: While the castle is preparing a surprise party for Esteban, Elena and Mateo take him sailing to an island where the Fountain of Youth is located. Elena and Mateo must save Esteban when he drinks too much water and becomes younger.

5.o: On the night Elena decides to appoint Mateo as Royal Wizard of Avalor, an evil malvago and old enemy of Alakazar named Fiero turns her family and the citizens to stone. Mateo must put his skills to the test to stop Fiero and save the people of Avalor

6.o: Elena visits the Kingdom of Cordoba to oversee construction of a bridge between it and Avalor but is convinced by lazy and spoiled Prince Alonso to shirk her royal duties. Elena must save the kingdom when the digging awakens a totem giant from Mayan folklore named the Yacalli.

7.o: During an archeological dig, Esteban accidentally releases a mischievous duende, a magical elf-like creature based on Latino folklore, who sets out on a mission to unleash hundreds of other duendes on Avalor.

8.o: Elena attends her first Royal Retreat as Crown Princess and learns that it is more important to do what is right than to fit in after a clashing disagreement with one of her fellow rulers.

9.o: On Dia de los Muertos, Elena discovers her ability to see ghosts and sets out to help the spirit of a woman mend the rift between her grandchildren and save the family restaurant.

10.o: When a moth fairy tries to bring "the gift of eternal darkness" to Avalor during a solar eclipse, Elena must learn how to control the magic in her royal scepter.

11.t: Elena and the Secret of Avalor
11.o: Elena laments how she was trapped in the magical Amulet of Avalor for forty-one years, until she was set free by a brave young Princess: Sofia The First.

12.o: Elena brings all the communities of Avalor together to share each other's holiday traditions. But when a Doña Paloma scheme causes an overly competitive atmosphere, Elena sets off on a traditional "parranda" and carols through the city to remind everyone of the true spirit of Navidad.

13.o: Elena helps coach Gabe when he joins Avalor's Royal "olaball" team despite being a terrible player.

14.o: Skylar is chosen to help train three young jaquins on defending the kingdom of Avalor.

15.o: On Isabel’s first day of school, she tries changing herself in order to fit in on a field trip to the Crystal Caverns.

16.o: Elena enters a fencing tournament disguised as "Knight Elezar" to prove that she is a great fencer.

17.o: Naomi's mom gets a new job in their old kingdom. Naomi and Elena try to convince her not to move the family away from Avalor.

18.o: Esteban’s childhood friend, Victor, returns to Avalor during the kingdom’s Carnaval celebration and convinces Esteban to help him rob the royal treasury.

19.o: When Elena finds out that her best friend Naomi's sixteenth birthday is coming up, she decides to throw her a Royal Quinceanera at the palace! But when Naomi becomes obsessed with having the perfect party, their friendship is put to the test.

20.o: Elena must rescue Mateo when an unruly spirit monkey launches him into the Spirit World.

21.o: Mateo takes on an apprentice, but soon discovers teaching is harder than it looks.

22.o: Elena travels to the realm of the jaquins, but unknowingly puts Avalor in danger.

23.o: Elena and her sister Isabel must work together to help undo a curse when an explorer is turned into a gecko.

24.o: Elena and her friends get stranded on a sailboat and are rescued by a mysterious ship.

25.o: Elena and her friends are transformed into sculptures!

26.o: Elena must work with Doña Paloma to break a spell.

1.t: Ismael "El Mayo" Zambada Garcia: The Head of the Sinaloa Cartel
1.o: حتى بعد اعتقال ابنه ومساعده الأبرز، يُشتبه في أن الزعيم المزعوم لكارتل سينالوا لا يزال يحكم منطقته في المكسيك.

2.t: Félicien Kabuga: The Financer of the Genocide in Rwanda
2.o: متهم بتمويل الإبادة الجماعية في رواندا في التسعينيات، يمضي رجل الأعمال عقودًا في الإفلات من السلطات.

3.o: بريطانية اعتنقت الإسلام تندد بهجمات قطارات أنفاق لندن عام 2005، ثم يُشتبه لاحقًا في أنها تدبّر أعمالًا إرهابية.

4.t: Semion Mogilevich: The Russian Mafia Boss
4.o: يُطرد الرجل الذي يُعتقد أنه «زعيم الزعماء» في المافيا الروسية من المجر ويعود إلى روسيا، حيث يظل قويًا وطليقًا.

5.t: Matteo Messina Denaro: Cosa Nostra's Last Godfather
5.o: يُشتبه في أنه دبّر اغتيال قاضيين وسلسلة هجمات إرهابية عام 1993، ولا يزال طليقًا هاربًا من العدالة.

1.o: Katie, a frustrated cable news producer, is horrified when her mom, Carol, gets an internship at "The Breakdown."  Despite Katie's best efforts, Carol is instantly beloved by the entire office, including blowhard veteran anchor Chuck. But when Katie hits a roadblock while producing a big story, she realizes that maybe having a mom at work isn't such a bad thing.

2.o: Katie tries to set workplace boundaries with Carol, but when a big story about an escaped bear lands in her lap, her mom can't help but meddle. Meanwhile, Greg tries to get Chuck and Portia to do a little friendly banter at the end of the show.

3.o: Chuck is having cataract surgery and, for the first time ever, must miss a day of work. Carol, eager to shirk her overwhelming intern duties, offers to take care of him. Meanwhile, Katie is excited for a peaceful day but with Chuck gone, Greg is reluctant to be the bad guy. As a result, "The Breakdown" descends into chaos as Greg is forced to say yes to Portia, Justin and everyone else's "great ideas for the show."

4.o: Katie's secret war reporter boyfriend, Trip, is back in town and working at the MMN offices. Despite Katie's best efforts, Carol quickly uncovers the covert relationship using a plan she stole from "Days of Our Lives". Meanwhile, Chuck, feeling threatened by Trip, is determined to return to the field. Greg and Justin support the idea until they find footage of Chuck's time as a war reporter in the '90s.

5.o: A huge snowstorm traps everyone in the building overnight. Meanwhile, Portia convinces Katie that Chuck's romantically interested in her; and Carol saves the day when she breaks into the offices of their competitor and steals all the morning show's wine.

6.o: Katie gets an opportunity to appear on the air after a field reporter is exposed as an arsonist, leading Carol to embrace the role of stage mom. Meanwhile, Chuck tries to compose a new theme song for the show after growing jealous of Portia's creative pursuits.

7.o: Carol is excited when Chuck asks her to wait for the cable guy at his townhouse, until Chuck gives an ominous warning that tests her curiosity. Meanwhile, Portia's phone gets hacked and Katie struggles not to read her private emails.

8.o: Katie secretly investigates a celebrity phone hacking ring behind Greg's back. In Katie's absence, Carol falls into producing a piece on her favorite phone game, "Biscuit Blitz." Meanwhile, Chuck gets in hot water when Portia accuses him of mansplaining.

9.o: Carol has a midterm she must pass in order to keep her internship. Katie needs to choose between helping her mom and focusing on her hacking story, which she can't seem to crack. Meanwhile, Greg's wealthy estranged grandmother pays a visit to the office. Chuck finds her cold and cruel, but almost immediately falls in love with her.

10.o: Katie makes a huge discovery about the story she's been chasing and, with the help of Carol and the rest of the staff, concocts a scheme to get the story out. Greg struggles with balancing his conflicting loyalties to his family, co-workers and conscience.

1.o: "The Breakdown" gets a new boss, Diana St. Tropez, a tough business lady with big plans to bring their outdated news program into the 21st century. Katie is thrilled since this is exactly the kind of strong, professional female role model she hoped for, but Carol is immediately wary of this new influence in Katie's life. Meanwhile, Chuck has trouble adapting to Diana's idea for a new panel segment of screaming pundits.

2.o: Diana sets Katie off on a mission to take the job at the station that she wants, but when Katie tries to be executive producer for the day, she soon realizes that Greg has it much harder than she realized. Meanwhile, Carol uses Greg and Katie's workplace competition as an opportunity to push the two of them together. After Diana insults Portia on a women-in-business panel, Portia declares a "squad feud" that forces their two very different worlds together.

3.o: Diana has been promoted again, this time to the head of the corporation that owns MMN, but before she leaves she finds herself embroiled in a sexual harassment scandal. This leaves Katie unsure who to believe - her mentor or her friends in the office. Carol becomes head intern and struggles to prove to the other interns, and herself, that she deserves the job.

4.o: When the show is nominated for an American Journalism Award, Katie looks forward to spending the night with reporters she has admired her entire life; Chuck is eager to reunite with all of his old anchormen friends.

5.o: Katie tries to impress her friends by going to a hip Halloween party with Portia; Chuck is asked to use a new smart screen on the show but tries to get out of it by convincing Carol that it is possessed.

6.o: Katie is invited by Jeremy to do some real reporting; Carol is suspicious and kidnaps Greg to help her spy on them; Chuck bonds with Portia's fiancé.

7.o: Carol finds herself in a reverse "Christmas Carol" during which she learns that she has too much Christmas spirit and is driving everyone around her insane. Meanwhile, Chuck's estranged son, Petey, visits the office and Katie, who has been charged with babysitting him, tries to get the father and son to reconnect.

9.o: Carol is devastated to learn that her parents are getting a divorce after 70 years of marriage. Katie, still hurting from her breakup with Jeremy, is convinced that love is dead, but Carol is determined to prove that it's never too late to have a happy ending. Meanwhile, Chuck discovers that the reason for Justin's newfound happiness is the cute new barista at the coffee shop and proceeds to compete for her affection at the expense of his and Justin's friendship.

10.o: Carol hatches a plan to get Katie to admit her feelings for her boss; Chuck finds himself an unwitting champion of the alt-right.

11.o: When "The Breakdown" staff finds themselves embroiled in a lawsuit with eccentric billionaire Fenton Pelt, Chuck is convinced he can solve the problem. But when Chuck's attempts to save the show backfire, he enlists the gang's help to pull off an elaborate heist. Meanwhile, after realizing that she has feelings for Greg, Katie is determined not to make a move on her unavailable boss. Her intentions are put to the test, however, when Diana St. Tropez demands that the two spend the night together fact-checking a story.

12.o: After an explosive fight with her daughter, Carol is excited about her new position at "Morning Wined Up," but is disappointed to realize that the job offers less responsibility than she had hoped. Katie is determined to bring down Fenton Pelt, the billionaire suing "The Breakdown," despite specific orders from Greg and the network's attorney to leave him alone. When Katie's rousing speech about journalistic integrity fails to inspire anyone but Chuck, who has been suspended from the show, she reluctantly joins forces, only to find that his investigative skills aren't what they used to be.

13.o: Diana St. Tropez returns with good news for "The Breakdown" staff: Fenton Pelt has agreed to drop his lawsuit on the condition that Chuck Pierce deliver a humiliating on-air apology and resign from news forever. Chuck, defeated, agrees, until Portia reminds him why he got into journalism in the first place. With Chuck's final broadcast approaching, Katie convinces Carol to reunite for one last job, and they race against the clock to find the one person in New Jersey who could disprove Fenton Pelt's claims and save the show.

5.o: With Luna behaving strangely, Januária fetches help from a healer. Unable to remember his encounter with Manaus, Eric gets a memory booster from Ciço.

6.o: Luna coaxes Saci to take her to Curupira. Ciço tells Afonso about Dry Body's curse. Eric and friends try to get to Luna before she finds her target.

7.o: Inês consoles a guilt-ridden Curupira, while Camila goes after Eric. In the forest, everyone gathers as Eric goes to extremes while battling the curse.

2.o: After removing Bento's curse, Eric uses his new powers to search for Luna. Débora finds a new key to Marangatu and sets up a very private auction.

3.o: Lazo and Luna become friends while locked up in captivity. Meanwhile, Eric, Clarice and Inês try to invade Débora's secret auction to set them free.

1.t: Kiyo and Sumire / Menu for a Special Day / Secret Supper Plan
1.o: Kiyo works at the Maiko House as the live-in cook. She sees her childhood friend Sumire in town one day, accompanying older maiko. Back at the House kitchen, Sumire tells Kiyo how hard she is working towards her goal of becoming one, too. Sumire is overjoyed to learn that she will debut as a maiko later that evening. She runs straight to Kiyo to share her news, but what will she think?

2.t: For Sleepless Nights / Some Things Will Always Be / Snowy Day Reminiscence
2.o: Sumire is going to have her hair styled in the traditional maiko bun for the first time. She will start using a special pillow to protect her hairstyle while she sleeps, like the other maiko and senior apprentices with buns. The senior maiko warn her she won't be able to sleep the first night, and Sumire struggles to rest her head on the unfamiliar pillow. She finally gives up on sleep and goes to the kitchen, where she unexpectedly finds Kiyo waiting up for her.

3.t: Kiyo Arrives in Kyoto (Part 1) / Kiyo Arrives in Kyoto (Part 2) / An Apprentice Maiko's Morning
3.o: About a year ago, in Aomori Prefecture. Kiyo is spending time with her grandma while getting ready for her and Sumire's departure to Kyoto that evening. Later, Kiyo, Sumire and Kenta have fun reminiscing about their childhood, and Kiyo's grandma serves them a specialty dish from the region to celebrate. Just before boarding the night bus, Sumire discovers what Kiyo has packed from home, as her grandma and Kenta look on.

4.t: What I Want to Eat / A Senior Apprentice's Evening / Debut Day
4.o: Kiyo is having trouble deciding what to cook for supper. She asks the maiko what they want to eat, but they all like different dishes. Sumire's favorite is fried chicken. Her craving grows so strong that it is all she can think about while entertaining customers over dinner, and on her way home. When she finally arrives back at the Maiko House, she is greeted by Kiyo, who is preparing an unexpected supper for her.

5.t: A Day in Kiyo's Life / Homemade Curry / Snowy Morning
5.o: Kiyo's day revolves around cooking and nourishing the maiko. In the morning, she gets ready quietly so as not to disturb the sleeping maiko, makes breakfast and goes grocery shopping after seeing the maiko off. Mid-day, she prepares lunch for the maiko who have returned from lessons, preps ingredients and serves supper to the maiko before they leave for entertaining. At evening time, Kiyo cleans up before going to the public bath and takes a stroll enjoying Kyoto at night.

6.t: Waiting for a Letter / Christmas in Kagai / New Year's Eve in Kagai
6.o: Aomori Prefecture. Kenta pays a visit to Kiyo's Grandma's and notices that she has received a letter in her mailbox. When Kenta realizes it is from Kiyo, he remembers how she and Sumire secretly exchanged notes in school. It was then that something about Kiyo's handwriting had started catching his attention.

7.t: First Day Home / New Year's Shrine Visit / Back to Kyoto
7.o: Kiyo has come home to Aomori Prefecture to spend New Year's with her grandma. Sumire and Kenta come to visit, and the three of them chat while making the hometown specialty walnut sauce for Ozoni soup. As she grinds the walnuts, Kiyo talks proudly about how amazing Sumire is performing as a maiko in Kagai as the others wonder, how about Kiyo?

8.t: First Day of Work / Opening Ceremony / White Dove
8.o: January 7 is the first workday of the new year in Kagai. The Maiko House girls are rushing about, preparing for the beginning of work. Sumire has her hair put up, gives Mother a personal New Year's greeting, and gets dressed in a formal black crested kimono worn on celebratory occasions. In the kitchen, Kiyo prepares a special breakfast for this important day, but the maiko must take particular care when eating it.

9.t: Something Warm for Lunch / When You Have a Cold... / Making Greeting Rounds
9.o: Mother brings home some premium beef. Kiyo immediately starts thinking about what she can make with it, but the maiko who have returned home are realizing that the house is unusually cold. None of the heating appliances could be turned on due to a blackout. As the maiko sit shivering in the cold, what better than Kiyo appearing in front of them with a steaming hot pot.

10.t: Night for Extra Effort / Bean Throwing for Everyone / Drink for an Energy Boost
10.o: It is customary for Geiko to dress up in costumes for the Setsubun festival in Kagai. The House maiko are up late, helping make the props and costumes. The girls are sleep-deprived, and they start to come apart in the room where they've been working together, as the night wears on. Can Sumire find something in the kitchen to help calm everyone down?

11.t: A Meal Request / Maiko Sisters Giving Their All / Kiyo, Same as Always
11.o: Sumire dines out at a high-end restaurant along with Momoko and a regular customer but cannot make any sense of the menu. Sumire ends up having the same meal as Momoko but is left wondering what she actually ate. The next morning, she goes to Kiyo in the house kitchen and makes a request for the dish she had wanted to eat.

12.t: Sumire's Day Off (Part 1) / Sumire's Day Off (Part 2)
12.o: The maiko spot garlic in the kitchen and it causes quite a stir among them. As entertainers, maiko typically refrain from eating anything that smells too strongly and can only enjoy having such foods when they have the next day off. The garlic is for Sumire's gyoza dumplings. She is looking forward to them so much that she blurts out some puzzling words while she entertains customers the night before her day off.

2.t: When nothing is what it seems (Cuando nada es lo que parece)
2.o: Rattled to learn that Gari has a disability, María attempts to talk to him and open her mind, while Cris struggles to reignite her marriage’s dwindling flame.

3.t: When you take an unexpected path (Cuando tomas un camino inesperado)
3.o: María and Gari weigh the risks of having a baby together. Meanwhile, Esther’s social media presence flails, and Cris plays with fire on a dating site.

4.t: When you confess to your parents (Cuando te confiesas con tus padres)
4.o: María attempts to open up to her parents about her pregnancy - but ends up forcing Gari to open up to her instead. Meanwhile, Esther realizes her career and personal growth are stunted.

5.t: When you want to, but you can’t (Cuando quieres y no puedes)
5.o: María looks to quench an uncontrollable libido. Esther reaches a career low. Cris turns to strangers to fill the void left by Pablo.

6.t: When you don’t want to be alone (Cuando no quieres estar sola)
6.o: At their 15-year high school reunion, María and Cris contemplate how far they’ve strayed from the lives they once envisioned for themselves.

7.t: When everything falls apart (Cuando todo se derrumba)
7.o: While Esther hits rock bottom on her 40th birthday, María tries to get Gari comfortable with Gustavo, and Cris lets her guard down at home.

8.t: When you let yourself go (Cuando te dejas llevar)
8.o: María’s wedding day is full of surprises that give her, Esther, and Cris some overdue clarity on what they want out of life.

1.o: Six months after Juanito’s birth, María struggles with post-partum blues, and Gari sets out to get his driver’s license. Meanwhile, Cris and Pablo look to spice up their marriage, and Esther disappears into a new relationship.

2.t: When you try to start over again (Cuando intentas volver a empezar)
2.o: At therapy, María finally digs into her true feelings towards motherhood. Cris and Pablo navigate the reality of open boundaries, Esther and Julia’s visions for the future start to clash, and later, María reconnects with Xosé.

3.t: When you want what you can't have (Cuando quieres lo que no tienes)

4.o: While Esther remains apprehensive about their impending nuptials, Júlia immerses herself in her fiancé’s world. As he grows closer to María and Juanito, Xosé gets cold feet. Cris ignores Pablo’s plea for monogamy.

5.t: When you get lost in the woods (Cuando te pierdes en el bosque)
5.o: A few days before her wedding, Esther brings María and Cris on spiritual retreat – and promptly goes AWOL. Xosé curries favor after helping Gari and Mónica rescue a wounded bird.

6.t: When you look at yourself in the mirror (Cuando te miras en el espejo)
6.o: On her wedding day, Esther must finally make a choice. Meanwhile, Cris is forced to confront the state of her own marriage, and María contemplates the future of her relationships with her son, her exes, and herself.

1.o: تبدأ معاناة خليل مع أهله بسبب الفقر في يوم حصوله علي المركز الأول في الابتدائية لمحافظة الشرقية، حيث يتم الحجز علي أثاث منزله بسبب إسراف الشيخ حسن في إقراض الناس دون إثبات حقه.

2.o: سافر خليل وأحمد ابن عمته للزقازيق للدراسة، وما زال خليل وأحمد يبذلا قصارى جهدهما للحصول علي مجانية التعليم، ويعاني خليل وأحمد من سوء معاملة سعداوي الأمي لهما.

3.o: ينجح خليل وأحمد بتفوق، وساءت أحوال أمينة، ويعاني خليل وأحمد من قلة الطعام فيجبروا على سرقة زملائهما.

4.o: عاد خليل وأحمد إلى البلد، بينما يتم القبض علي الشيخ حسن لعدم سداده الدين، ومرت الأيام ليعمل خليل ملاحظ فلاحين بأرض الوسية المملوكة للخواجة تاكي الذي يعجب بأمانته، ويقطن عند الشيخ سالم.

5.o: تزداد كراهية حسين لخليل بعد تسلمه مسؤولية مخازن الوسية بدلاً منه، ومازالت محاولات إقناع الخواجة تاكي لوالده بزواجه من كاريوبي تبوء بالفشل لكونها راقصة، ويطلب سالم من خليل السكوت عن سرقة حسين للمخازن خوفاً من استغناء الخواجة عن العاملين.

6.o: يرفض الغفير خطاب تصديق خليل في سرقة حسين للمخازن رغم رؤيته لذلك، ويكتشف خليل تواطؤ تاكي مع حسين في سرقة الفلاحين، ويساعد خليل أحد الفلاحين في سرقة الذرة بعدما تأكد من سرقة الخواجه لحق هذا الفلاح.

7.o: يطرد تاكي - حسين، وأصبح خليل باشكاتب الوسية، الأمر الذي أفرح الفلاحين لتخلصهم ممن يسرقهم جاهلين السارق الحقيقي، ومازالت تحب نبيهة - خليل بينما هو لم ينسي حبه لعلياء ابنة عمته.

8.o: استغل خليل سفر الخواجه وزار علياء وعمته، كونهما في زيارة لقرية قريبة منه، ويفاجأ خليل بتواطؤ سالم مع أبو زيد مقاول الأنفار في النصب علي الخواجة.

9.o: تستر خليل علي تواطؤ سالم مع أبو زيد، وتستمر المناوشات بين تاكي وأخيه نيكولا ليقنعه بزواجه من كاريوبي رغماً عن أبيه سيماريدس، فيتهم تاكي نيكولا بأنه يريد أن يحرمه من الميراث بهذا الزواج لعدم رضا والده.

10.o: طلب سيماريدس من تاكي الزواج من ابنة صاحبة ولكنه رفض، وتشاجر تاكي مع خليل بسبب رفضه النصب علي الفلاحين في حقوقهم، ورفض أن يكون نسخه أخري من حسين، وتنقل خبر وقوف خليل أمام تاكي واتجه كل الفلاحين للسرايا للمطالبة بحقوقهم.

11.o: أطلق تاكي النار لتفريق الفلاحين، وتعدت الشرطة عليهم دون تحقيق، وسافر خليل ليجد أبيه تاركاً عمله بسبب مرضه، وطلب من خليل عدم الخضوع لتاكي، فاضطر أن يعود لتوفير قوت عائلته.

12.o: ذهب خليل مع والده للمستشفي لمرضه وتركه مع لاشين زوج عمته، واستجاب أبيه للشفاء، وما زالت محاولات إشراك خليل في السرقة مستمرة.

13.o: عاتب خليل والدته لقبولها قمح مسروق عن طريق خطّاب، ومازال سالم يسرق الخواجة، وهرب خليل لبلده بعدما حاول تاكي إطلاق الرصاص عليه، ومازال يبحث خليل عن عمل لتوفير قوت عائلته

14.o: تطوع خليل بالجيش بمدرسة ضباط الصف بمصر لتوفير قوت عائلته، وزار علياء وعمته وتلقي معاملة سيئة من رأفت ابن عمته، وتخرج خليل وتم تعيينه معلما بالمدرسة لتفوقه.

15.o: يعمل خليل ومرتجي لإلغاء نظام المراسلة بين العساكر والضباط، وعلي إثر هذا يخطب خليل بالإذاعة، وتسعد علياء بنجاحاته فيستغل الفرصة ليعترف بحبه لها، بينما مازالت عمته تراه أقل منهم شأناً.

16.o: يترقى خليل لرتبة باش شاويش، ويتم إختياره ليكون في حراسة رئيس أركان حرب الجيش، وينجح خليل بالتوجيهية، وينوي استكمال دراسته، بينما ترفض علياء طلب رأفت بأن تتزوج من ابن القائد الخاص به.

17.o: يقوم خليل بزيارة علياء ليري فرحتها بنجاحه فيجدها تتزوج من ابن القائد الخاص برأفت، وينهار خليل فيشجعه أقرانه بالجيش من استكمال تعليمه، ويشتري الشيخ حسن فدانين مما ادخره خليل، ويلتحق خليل بكلية الحقوق.

18.o: يمارس خليل عمله بالكلية بصفته العسكرية ويدرس بالجامعة ذاتها، ويضطر لتوثيق شهادة الفقر ليحصل علي المجانية، ويشارك خليل بمظاهرات ضد الاستعمار متناسياً رتبته، ولا زالت ترغب كل التيارات السياسية في ضمه لحزبها فيرفض.

19.o: يُقبض علي خليل شكاً منهم أنه علي معرفة بإرهابيين ويخلي سبيله مع الوعد بالتعاون مع البوليس السياسي، وتخرج واحتفل وسط أهله وحصل علي دبلومة القانون العام والاقتصاد.

1.t: If She Could See Us Now
1.o: Following the death of their childhood friend, three women make a series of life-altering decisions.

2.o: Survivor's guilt causes Amy to spin out, thinking that death is around every corner. Jodie's relationship with her trainer seems to take on a new light after she has a heroic moment, and Sarah gets bullied for not slacking enough at her new "relaxing" job.

3.o: In a desperate attempt to prove she's fun, Sarah drags Amy and Jodie out on a night of hijinks. Amy struggles to balance a work crisis and her new dedication to motherhood and Jodie's anxiety takes over after sending a flirty text to Matt without a response.

4.o: Sarah begins to dip her toes into the dating pool and enlists Amy and Jodie's help in vetting a woman whom she ran across on a dating app. Meanwhile, Amy's maternal instincts are tested when she learns Luke isn't fitting in with other kids. Then, Matt comes to Jodie for business advice, causing her to reflect on how she's appreciated within her own family.

5.o: Sarah, Amy and Jodie's made-up annual holiday, "D-Day," celebrates a major moment from Beverly Hills, 90210. Jodie clings to every aspect of the tradition, despite Coleen's absence. Meanwhile, Amy attempts to use the holiday as a day of respite from her family and Sarah worries she's too old to get back into the dating scene.

6.o: Amy tries to think before she speaks after learning that Luke has been using offensive language at school. Meanwhile, Sarah and Brian begin to butt heads when they realize that Coleen shared details with both of them that they thought were said privately. Then, Jodie sees a glimpse of sweetness from her husband and internally struggles with her recent Pivot of attaining her goal weight.

7.o: Amy learns that's Coleen's old cell phone number has been given to someone else and goes to great lengths to get it back. Meanwhile, Sarah continues to date, but is quickly reminded that Brian needs help setting up for Lila's first birthday party. Then, Jodie helps Matt organize his bedroom and they get closer than ever.

8.o: After one of Luke's teachers asks Amy to share prescription pills, the teacher repays Amy by doing a good deed in return, forcing Amy and Henry to cover up the accidental bribe. Meanwhile, Jodie almost blows her cover with Matt and Sarah commits to saying "yes" to new things.

9.o: Sarah and Jodie learn of a local mom's scandalous Fans Only page and become intrigued by the potential financial upside. Exhausted and baffled by Henry's inability to keep his hands off Amy, she tries to get to the bottom of this change in his behavior.

10.o: Amy, Sarah and Jodie each reach different crossroads and decide to put their issues on the backburner to celebrate Coleen's birthday. The ladies bring Coleen's ashes out for a girl's night that ends in turmoil.

João Guimarães Rosa is sent to Hamburg and is introduced to Aracy at the consulate. The repression of Jews increases. Vivi is bothered by young Nazis, but Zumkle makes them stop.

2.o: The murder of a German diplomat by a Jew leads to Crystal Night. Helena tries to convince Vivi to spy on SS officers. Rudi is arrested. João discovers Aracy's scheme.

3.o: Zumkle promises Vivi that he will free his father. The captain follows Aracy and discovers that she is helping Hugo and Margarethe. João and Aracy are observed by Zumkle.

4.o: Zumkle takes advantage of the expropriation of non-Aryan businesses. Vivi decides to help Helena by getting information for the resistance. Zumkle makes a false complaint against João.

5.o: Gestapo investigates Hardner and João. Vivi seduces Schaffer to get information. Zumkle tries to force Aracy a kiss; she hits him. Schaffer discovers that Vivi is Jewish.

6.o: Rudi and Helena participate in a frustrated attack on Goebbels at the Embassy of Portugal, where Aracy and João were. A bomb hits the Brazilian consulate.

7.o: Hamburg is under constant air attack. João helps Mina's son, who returned from the traumatized war front. Aracy asks Zumkle for help, who wants something in return.

8.o: Hardner, Aracy and João plan Rudi's escape. Zumkle is determined to end the plan and follows João. Aracy and João are arrested and return to Brazil after forced exile.

1.o: يفقد "بيدرو" وظيفته، وتنتقل ابنة "سانتي" للعيش معه، وتشعر زوجة "لويس" بعدم الرضا عن حياتهما الجنسية، وتسير خطّة "راؤول" بشأن التقدّم للزواج على عكس ما تخيّله.

2.o: يستثقل "بيدرو" حياة البطالة، ويجرّب "لويس" و"إيستر" التحدّث إلى أخصائية علاج جنسي، ويكتشف "راؤول" أمرًا جديدًا حول والديه... كحال "سانتي" مع "أليكس".

3.o: ينتقل "راؤول" للعيش مع "سانتي" الذي يواجه نجاحًا جزئيًّا في مواعداته، وتسير مهنة "دانييلا" على ما يرام ممّا يزيد من إحباط "بيدرو"، بينما تجرّب "إيستر" بعض الأدوية.

4.o: يسافر الرجال إلى "إيبيزا" ويحاول "سانتي" إقناعهم باختيار ألفاظهم، ثم يواجه "بيدرو" مشكلة محتملة أو بالأدق مشكلتين، وتذهب "إيستر" إلى النادي الرياضي باستمرار.

5.o: يجاهد "راؤول" للتأقلم مع وضعه الجديد، فيما يحاول "بيدرو" التسجيل للحصول على إعانة البطالة ويرتكب خطأً فادحًا، ويبحث "لويس" و"سانتي" عن صديق مثليّ.

6.o: يحضر الشباب ندوة عن الذكورة السامّة، ويحظى "سانتي" بموعد موفّق فيما تبوء محاولات "راؤول" بالفشل. وتعرض "دانييلا" وظيفة على "بيدرو"، ويكتشف "لويس" أمرًا ما.

7.t: When Was the Last Time You Cried?
7.ar: متى كانت آخر مرة بكيت فيها؟
7.o: تقترح "لوز" فكرة جديدة، فيما يستاء "بيدرو" و"دانييلا" من ترتيبات عملهما. ويحاول "لويس" و"إيستر" التفاوض، بينما يريد "سانتي" الالتزام بعلاقة... ولكن ما مدى صحة الأمر يا ترى؟

8.t: Just When We Were Doing So Well
8.ar: عندما كانت علاقتنا تسير بشكل رائع
8.o: يتبنى "بيدرو" قضية جديدة كمؤثّر، ويظن "راؤول" و"دانييلا" أنّ ثمة أمرًا تخفيه "لوز" و"بيدرو"، ويصعب على "سانتي" اتّخاذ قرار.

9.o: تنتشر مقاطع فيديو عن تأييد "بيدرو" للرجولة بشكل واسع ممّا يهدد مسيرة "دانييلا" المهنية، بينما تقدّم "يوجينيا" إلى "سانتي" مفاجأة غير مرحّب بها، وتتّخذ "لوز" و"راؤول" خطوة جريئة.

10.t: Either the Course Is a Failure, or We Are
10.ar: إمّا أنّ الدورة كانت فاشلة، أو نحن الفاشلون
10.o: يرتكب "راؤول" خطأً جسيمًا وتتخذ "دانييلا" قرارًا مفجعًا، ويقوم "سانتي" بمفاجأة "أليكس" بأمر سيئ، وينظّم "لويس" و"إيستر" لإقامة حفل عيد ميلاد.

1.o: يعود "بيدرو" إلى سوق العمل من جديد، ويتعرض ابن "لويس" للتنمر في المدرسة. وفي الوقت الذي يخطط فيه "راؤول" لمصالحة "لويس"، لا يبدو "سانتي" سعيدًا مع "بلانكا".

2.o: تشعل زميلة "لويس" الجديدة في الدورية غيرة "إيستر" من جهة، وتلفت انتباه "راؤول" من جهة أخرى. فيما يوظف "بيدرو" شخصًا لمرافقته إلى فعالية رسمية، ويُجري "سانتي" مقابلة عمل.

3.o: يُمنع "سانتي" من المغازلة في مكان العمل، إلا أن المغريات تتجلى أمامه، فيما يزداد التوتر بين "بيدرو" ومديرته. أما "لوز"، فتساورها شكوك تتعلق بالأمومة.

4.o: تسافر المجموعة إلى "مالقة" طلبًا لمشورة "باتريك"، لكن ينتهي بها الأمر في حفلة بمنزل ثري روسي، فيما تخرج صفوف الدراما التي تشارك فيها "إيستر" عن السيطرة.

5.ar: لا تتهور وتقع في حبها الآن
5.o: يكوّن "راؤول" صداقات جديدة، ويشك "لويس" بأن زوجته ترغب بالمزيد من الإثارة في علاقتهما الحميمية. أما "بيدرو"، فيحتفل بإنجاز في العمل، بينما يواجه "سانتي" المتاعب مع مديره.

6.o: بعد أن يتم طرده من منزل "بيدرو"، يتواصل "راؤول" مع زوجة "سانتي" من خلال تطبيق للمواعدة. فيما تعاني "لوز" مع "هكتور" وابنه، بينما يستكشف "لويس" آفاق علاقته المفتوحة.

7.o: توجّه "باولا" إنذارًا نهائيًا لـ"سانتي"، ويزور "بيدرو" طبيبًا للمسالك البولية. أما "راؤول"، فيدفع الأصدقاء نحو تجربة يتضح لاحقًا أنها ترفع الرسميات أكثر من اللازم.

8.o: تعتقد "إيستر" بأن "لويس" مثلي الجنس، فيما يبحث "سانتي" جاهدًا عن فيديو "باولا". أما "بيدرو"، فيحاول زيادة خصوبته، ويستمر "راؤول" في تجاربه.

9.t: What Does It Mean to Be a Woman?
9.o: تنظّم "دانييلا" حفلة مفاجئة لـ"بيدرو"... وتوجّه دعوة إلى "أنخيلا" لحضورها. ويزور "إيستر" و"لوز" ناديًا للبالغين، فيما تعلن "باتريسيا" عن أمر صادم.

10.t: The One Time We're All Together
10.ar: هذه المرة الوحيدة التي نجتمع فيها
10.o: يقضي الأزواج عطلة نهاية الأسبوع في "إيبيزا"، حيث تبدو على "إيستر" و"لوز" علامات البخل. ويشاهد الجميع مسلسل "بيدرو" الجديد والمألوف على نحو غريب.

1.o: يرحب "بيدرو" بالأبوة في حين يأسف "لويس" على انتهاء "عيد الأب"، وتخطف صحفية متمرسة قلب "سانتي"، وتلتهب الأجواء مع "راؤول" في الجنازة.

2.o: يحاول "لويس" التعامل مع طلاق والديه، وتعجز مديرة "بيدرو" الجديدة عن تقبّله. وبينما يعاني "راؤول" من الفوضى الرومانسية، يتبنى كلبًا ليشاركه مع "لوز".

3.t: Whoever Falls in Love First Loses
3.ar: من يقع في الحب أولًا هو الخاسر
3.o: يميل "راؤول" إلى المغازلة خلال اجتماع شمل الثانوية فيشعل غضب "لويس"، ويتصرف "سانتي" دون تعقّل في عرض "إيستر" الكوميدي، وتتلقى "لوز" تحفيزًا من شريكها على طلب المزيد في العمل.

4.o: يقيم "بيدرو" و"دانييلا" حفلة للكشف عن جنس الجنين، ويحصل "لويس" على فرصة تمثيل لأجل "إيستر"، ويأمل "سانتي" من "إريني" أن تفتح له قلبها، بينما يقف الدين في طريق "راؤول".

5.t: Hey, Hate to Burst Your Bubble, But...
5.o: ترتيبات "لويس" لرحلة رومانسية مع "إيستر" تتحول إلى نهاية أسبوع كاشفة للأسرار بالنسبة للأصدقاء، بينما تهدد أكاذيب "راؤول" على "ماريمار" بالعودة إلى مطاردته.

6.o: يجد "بيدرو" صعوبة في الحفاظ على علاقة الودّ مع "دانييلا". وخلال فعالية العزاب غير الطوعيين، يبالغ "سانتي" في التخفي، وتعيش "إيستر" حالة مثيرة بسبب قرص "راؤول" الصلب.

7.o: يخشى "سانتي" من تجاهل "إريني" له، وتذهب "لوز" بصحبة "دانييلا" إلى احتفالية، ويتواصل "راؤول" من جديد مع صديق مقرب، ويضطر "لويس" إلى التعامل مع مطالب والدته.

8.o: بينما يتقدم "راؤول" للزواج، تبلغ الخصومة بين "بيدرو" و"فيرخينيا" قمّتها. ويصادف "سانتي" وهو في حالة من التعاسة العديد من حبيباته السابقات، ويردد ابن "لويس" عبارات جده دون فهم.

9.o: تقيم "باز" حفل توديع العزوبية لـ"لوز"، ويعرض قسّ غير تقليدي على "راؤول" تقديم الإرشاد، ويلتقي "بيدرو" بشخصية من ماضيه وجهًا لوجه خلال اجتماع ترويجي محرج.

10.o: تشعر "دانييلا" بآلام المخاض في يوم زفاف "راؤول"، ويُعرض مسلسل "بيدرو" لأول مرة، ويتناول "سانتي" خليطًا محفزًا جنسيًا، في حين تكتشف "إيستر" أكاذيب "لويس" المؤلمة.

1.t: You Have to Get It In
1.o: Pedro gets a postpartum diagnosis. Marimar sends Raúl to conversion therapy. Santi has an AI companion. Esther falls asleep during a driving lesson.

2.o: Raúl hides his procedure from Marimar. Santi considers adoption, and Pedro gets a dating profile. Luis and Esther clumsily teach their son about sex.

3.o: The guys get the keys to their man cave. Pedro loses focus during a hot date, and Santi freaks out over test results. Raúl's parents drop a bombshell.

4.t: You Can Always Be a Bit Straighter
4.o: While the guys attend a brutal boot camp, the gals take a secret trip to Dubai. Eva digs into Santi's private life. Paz has a proposal for Luz.

5.o: The guys surprise Luis at his party, to Esther's dismay. Santi and Eva get closer. Raúl gets down to business with an old friend. Daniela gets jealous.

6.o: During a luxurious group trip to Punta Cana, the couples face pretty big problems as secrets tumble out and family dramas reach breaking point.

1.o: The man cave is too small for the friends' new singlehood. As Raúl embraces his faith, Luis and Esther go on dates. The women attend a feminist march.

2.t: How Did Humanity Get to This Point?
2.o: The guys find a site for their new women-free oasis. Method actor Mario learns more about Pedro. Esther's date has a fetish. Rafa propositions Raúl.

3.o: Álex moves into the man cave as the guys make a pact. Luis gets caught in a compromising position. Santi handles a desirous client with no support.

4.o: Esther gets a rogue request online. Santi moves into a caravan. Luz dishes dirt on Luis, while Pedro finds an unexpected escape from the daily grind.

5.o: Daniela, Esther and Luz attend a women's retreat to rediscover their femininity. Tania gives Pedro an ultimatum, while Luis' kids take drastic measures.

6.o: A mysterious wedding brings the gang together. Luz gets a reality check. Luis and Esther seal a deal. Raúl's romantic life is upended by a proposal.

1.o: The Killing Vote for vicious criminals begins. The death penalty is carried out according to the vote, and the investigation by the Special Investigation Headquarters starts.

2.t: The Devils Who Were Deemed Innocent
2.o: The second Killing Vote begins. The police struggle to stop the death penalty by Gaetal. The car containing the second victim and Mu-chan explodes.

3.o: Mu-chan injured in the explosion along with the second victim. Witnessing this, Joo Hyun falls into despair, and the story of Seok-joo in prison keeps repeating itself.

4.o: Mu-chan tries to find out the whole story of the current case by sending Joo Hyun, who was recruited in the special team, to Seok-joo. A video foretelling the third Killing Vote is emerging.

5.o: Seok-joo joins the police on the morning of the Killing Vote. The police are dispatched to rescue Captain Oh, who was designated as the victim, and they are one step closer to the identity of Gaetal.

6.o: Joo Hyun and Seok-joo chase after the person suspected. Mu-chan confronts Jin-wook, who tried to kill Captain Oh. The police announce that they have arrested Gaetal, but the true identity of Gaetal is revealed.

7.o: 8 years ago, the case between Mu-chan and Seok-joo is revealed. The story of Seok-joo's young daughter dying and Seok-joo killing the culprit himself. And who the accomplice of the dead criminal is revealed.

8.o: Public support for the Killing Vote is growing stronger. The police realize Lee Min-soo was the one who sent letters to Seok-joo as Number One Fan. As soon as Mu-chan accuses Seok-joo of being the real Gaetal, Seok-joo escapes.

9.o: Min-soo steals the Killing Vote system as Gaetal's identity is gradually revealed. While on the trail of discovering who Gaetal is, Joo Hyun infiltrates Min-soo's secret room.

10.o: Lee Min-soo's investigation is sluggish due to Min Ji-young's interference. Gaetal tries to judge Min-soo by putting him in the Killing Vote.

11.o: Apart from the Killing Vote, Min-soo is killed by Min Ji-young's scheme. Seok-joo tries to commit suicide by placing himself in the Killing Vote, and Ji-hoon tries to stop it.

12.o: The majority votes to abstain from executing Seok-joo, and his Killing Vote is canceled. As Seok-joo is about to hand over the voting program, Chul-min tackles him, and they both fall deep under water. Meanwhile, someone holds a Gaetal mask in their hand, and they put it on. Who could it be?

1.o: يصل الأصدقاء المقربون "سانتي" و"نيس" و"فيليكس" إلى ميامي وفي جعبتهم خطط طموحة، متأملين أن يطلق لقاؤهم الأول مع مسؤولة كبيرة في شركة تسجيلات مسيرة "سانتي" المهنية نحو القمة.

2.o: تستخدم "ميا" نفوذها لتمكين "سانتي" من تقديم عرض على مسرح نادٍ ليلي. فيما يكتشف "فيليكس" سرًا عن طريق الصدفة. أما "نيس"، فتبادر من أجل جذب انتباه صحفية متخصصة في مجال الموسيقى.

3.o: يُطلق "فيليكس" العنان لإبداعه من خلال تصوير فيديو موسيقي بإعادة توزيع أعدها "سانتي" لأغنية إعلان متجر البقالة، وتحاول "ميا" أن تصعد سلم النجاح سريعًا في العمل.

4.o: يذهب الفريق إلى حفل "آرت بازل" لأجل تأمين تمويل جديد، وهناك يصادف "سانتي" أحد منافسيه بينما تحاول "نيس" أن تبرع في أسلوب التفاعل مع الآخرين وتكوين علاقات.

5.o: يأتي استثمار مالي مشبوه بمزايا مبهرة مع بعض الشروط، وتجري "ميا" عملية تبديل محفوفة بالمخاطر في استوديو التسجيل بسبب شعورها بالقلق من خسارة "سانتي".

6.o: تبحث نجمة موسيقى البوب العالمية "إيسا" عن صوت جديد وعاشق جديد أيضًا، فيقع "سانتي" أسيرًا لحبها... ولكن ليس الجميع متحمسًا لتعاونهما.

7.o: في احتفال ترفيهي يستضيفه "دادي يانكي"، تهرع "ميا" لتوقيع عقد لصالح أول عملائها بينما يتواصل "سانتي" و"سيليست" مجددًا. أمّا "فيليكس"، فيواجه أزمة ثقة في النفس.

8.o: ينشغل جميع أفراد الطاقم بالتحضير لعرض "إيسا" المباشر في عشية رأس السنة. وحين يصبح مستقبله على المحك، يتعين على "سانتي" اتخاذ قرار بشأن ما هو أكثر أهمية.

1.o: يتم العثور على حُطام آلي سويسري محبوب. وفي تلك الأثناء، يتحرى المحقق "غيجيشت"، المعني بالآليين في الـ"يوروبول"، عن قضية أخرى غريبة ذات صلة.

2.o: يُعثر على جثة قتيل آخر غُرِس فيها قرنان. ويتواصل "غيجيشت" مع "أتوم"، وهو أكثر الآليين السبعة تطورًا، للمساعدة في تحليل جرائم القتل المتسلسلة.

3.o: يُستدعى "عبد الله" من قِبل مفوض الشرطة "طواش" بخصوص مقتل "تازاكي"، ويشتبه "غيجيشت" في تعرّض بياناته للاختراق.

4.o: يُحضر البروفيسور "أوتشانوميزو" كلبًا آليًّا محطمًا إلى البيت ويحاول إصلاحه. وبعد فترة وجيزة، يزوره في منزله رجل غامض يزعم أنه صاحب الكلب.

5.o: بعد توصيل "أدولف هاس" إلى منزل آمن، يبحث "غيجيشت" في ماضيه. وفي تلك الأثناء، يشعر "هركليز" و"إبسيلون" بتهديد غامض يقترب منهما.

6.o: يلتقي "غيجيشت" بـ"عبد الله" في "بلاد الفرس" ليتحرى أكثر عن القضية لكنه يكتشف كذبة، ثم يقترب قليلًا من الحقيقة حين يصادف طفلًا آليًّا.

7.o: يحاول الدكتور "تينما" استعادة "أتوم" مهما كلفه الأمر، وينصح مسؤول حكومي "إبسيلون" المهموم بالإخلاء لأنه سيكون الهدف التالي.

8.o: يراقب البروفيسور "أوتشانوميزو" سلوك "أتوم" الغريب عن كثب. ويواجه الدكتور "تينما" ماضيه وتتكشف الحقيقة التي تثير تهديدًا مدمرًا للعالم أجمع.

1.o: On the day the world should end and doesn't, Tomás returns home to apologize to his wife and daughter after taking off to live a crazy life months ago.

2.o: Julia wants to bury her father in the cemetery of her village but getting there is dangerous and she feels a bit lazy.

3.o: Tomás tries to relive the good old days by organizing a barbecue among friends. However, the problem is getting meat other than pigeon meat.

4.t: The Five Horsemen of the Apocalypse
4.o: Romero invites Tomás to join the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse, a group of white-brand avengers who fight the bad guys.

5.o: Julia goes partying with Noa and her post-adolescent friends. The night gets complicated.

6.o: Tomás and Julia come to terms with the one thing that unites them: their daughter.

1.o: Ga-min is passionate about studying and puts all his efforts into it. However, he never received a good grade, which made him go to Yusung Technical High School. The school is known as a gangster training school, and unlike Ga-min, not many students are into studying. However, Ga-min wants to try a new method of studying, which is forming a study group. He asks his classmate Se-hyun to join him, but he tells Ga-min about a problem he has.

2.o: Ga-min gets into an unexpected fight against Hyeon U, a school bully. As the fight goes on, the two become the center of attention of everyone in school. At that moment, a man enters the classroom that has become a mess because of the two, and it turns out that he is a school inspector. The vice-principal who got furious about the incident decides to expel Ga-min from school.

3.o: Someone applied to the study group. Ga Min is excited to meet the applicant, but it turns out that it is Ji U, Hyeon U’s twin sister. Kyu Jin, a member of the student council, picks on Ji U, and Ga Min confronts him. Han Wul tells Hyeon U about Kyu Jin who was blackmailing Ji U. Meanwhile, Ranked 1 among the 1st years comes to see Ga Min.

4.o: Jun is impressed by Ga Min who defeated the rankers. He applies to join the study group and asks Ga Min to teach him how to fight. However, Ga Min rejects him because he only wants students who actually want to study in the study group. Jun decides to join the gang to become stronger, but it only gets him in trouble. Ga Min and his friends go to rescue him.

5.o: The study group is finally complete. But the school’s top student, Kim Ho Min bullies Se Hyun, who grew up in the same neighbourhood. He tramples on Se Hyun’s pride and beats him up, calling him a poor loser. Ga Min steps up to help him, but it only makes Se Hyun feel like a real loser. After refusing to go to Ga Min’s house, Se Hyun wanders around and ends up running into Ho Min.

6.o: Ga Min breaks the curfew that he promised because of Se Hyun, and his mom tries to transfer him to another school. Han Kyeong and the study group, who can’t give up on Ga Min, persistently chase after Ga Min’s mom and try to persuade her. But that’s when the reserves of the Yeonbaek Gang barge in after finding out about Han Kyeong’s plan for Pi Han Wul.

7.t: Kim Sun Cheol Going to Prison
7.o: Ga Min runs into Pi Han Ul’s bodyguard, Kim Sun Cheol, at the hospital where his mother is hospitalized. Sun Cheol was working for Pi Han Ul because he needed to take care of his sick grandfather. In order to pay his grandfather’s hospital bills, Kim Sun Cheol decides to go to prison on the false charge of murder instead of Yeonbaek Gang. Ga Min finds out and steps forward to help Sun Cheol with his friends.

8.o: The Study Group sneaks into the Reserves General Meeting and struggles against the Yeonbaek Gang. Pi Han Ul forces Kim Sun Cheol to make a false confession to Detective Na Tae Man. Meanwhile, the fated midterm exam finally begins. The Study Group must improve their grades and climb up at least ten places to hold a disciplinary committee against Pi Han Ul. Will they all succeed?

9.o: The Student Council Committee will summon Han Ul, and Han Ul’s past is revealed. Han Ul comes up with a scheme to stop the committee. He makes fake news and puts it online to make it go viral. Because of this, the study group members are falsely accused of a school gang. Han Kyeong must make a choice to protect her students.

2.o: تبدأ الأمور بداية صعبة عندما يعلن "جاك" و"جينفيف" عن صفقة التبادل في مؤتمر صحفي مشترك. تبحث "شيان" عن شريك رقص مثالي في "نيويورك"، بينما تعاني "ميشي" و"توبياس" كي يجدا نفسيهما في "باريس".

3.o: يمر "جاك" بيوم عصيب. يختار "توبياس" الراقصين من أجل عرضه الجديد، بينما يتوق "غابن" إلى جذب الانتباه. تحصل "ميشي" على دور كبير، وتواجه "جينفيف" بشأن الماضي.

4.o: إنها ليلة الافتتاح! يتعامل "جاك" مع مشكلات الراقصين، بينما تتسبب "جينفيف" في مشكلة دولية. تزداد الأمور إثارة بين "شيان" و"غايل"، في حين يجد "توبياس" و"غابن" صعوبة في التواصل.

5.o: إنه موسم "كسّارة البندق"، ويتوسل فريق مسرح باليه العاصمة إلى "شيان" كي تؤدي رقصة "جنيّة السكر". كما أنه أيضاً عيد ميلاد "جاك"، و"جينفيف" في المدينة. تحاول "ميشي" التواصل مع "برونا". يعود "غابن" بعد إيقافه. وثمة جرذ في شقة "توبياس".

6.o: باليه "توبياس" الجديد كارثة. تبذل "جينفيف" قصارى جهدها لإرضاء الجميع، بينما يرفض "جاك" أن يتقاعد "نيكولاس". يتواجه "كريسبن" و"شيان" خلال أحد صفوف الباليه بالشركة، بينما تخرج "ميشي" في موعد غرامي.

7.o: يقع "غابن" في مشكلة، وتتعرض "ميشي" للتجاهل. يعاود الظهور شخص من ماضي "غايل"، في حين تزلّ قدم "شيان". يعاني "جاك" لاختيار خليفة "نيكولاس"، لكن "كريسبن" يقترح عليه اسماً.

8.o: يتخذ "جاك" قراراً جريئاً فيما يخص المدير الفني الجديد، مما يضعه في خلاف مع "جينفيف". يُعرض باليه "توبياس" الجديد لأول مرة، بينما ترقص "شيان" رقصة فردية مؤثّرة وهي تتساءل عن جدوى الخيارات التي اتخذتها في حياتها.
